# List projects — `redmine_list_projects`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.ts from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run gen:tools`. -->

_read-only_

List the projects the API key can see, optionally filtered by name, status, parent, or visibility — the standard "what projects exist" orientation call.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `active` \| `closed` \| `archived` | no | Lifecycle filter: "active" (default), "closed", or "archived". |
| `name` | string | no | Filter by project name (substring match). |
| `parent_id` | string | no | Only projects under this parent project id. |
| `is_public` | boolean | no | Filter by public (true) vs private (false) projects. |
| `include` | `trackers` \| `issue_categories` \| `time_entry_activities` \| `enabled_modules` \| `issue_custom_fields`[] | no | Associations to expand: "trackers", "issue_categories", "time_entry_activities", "enabled_modules", "issue_custom_fields". |
| `offset` | integer | no | Pagination offset (skip N projects). |
| `limit` | integer | no | Maximum number of projects to return. |

## Example

```json
{
  "name": "redmine_list_projects",
  "arguments": {
    "status": "active"
  }
}
```
